name: Matmul + scale + residual epilogue
description: Compute out = 0.5 * (a @ b) + c. float16 inputs/output, accumulate in float32. Fuse the epilogue into the matmul.
signature: run(a: Tensor[M, K], b: Tensor[K, N], c: Tensor[M, N]) -> Tensor[M, N]
provenance: Original KernelRL task (written from scratch). Task category inspired by KernelBench level 3 (github.com/ScalingIntelligence/KernelBench, MIT license); no KernelBench code copied.
